expected.frameCountRule: Planned exclusive end is 1800 s. Frame i presents at i * 1001/24000 s. Frames with PTS in [0, 1800) are i = 0 through 43156, so the count is 43157. Equivalently floor((1800 * 24000 - 1) / 1001) + 1. The duration of those 43157 frames is 43157 * 1001 / 24000 s, which is 1800.0065416 s. Fourteen chapters contribute 2877 frames and chapter 15 contributes 2879 frames.

humanViewingChecks: montage panel overlaps and motion look like distinct scenes, not colour bars only

thresholds.note: Cancel at minute 10 stops the worker within 5 s with no partial receipt.
Kill and reopen yields exactly one interrupted attempt.
A chapter 7 change re-renders only chapter 7 plus unclean adjacent boundaries. Checked separately from segment render reuse.
Joined output probes as one continuous stream with no timestamp discontinuity and no dropped audio sample.
